reason: My architect already does the 3D models and renders and it's baked into their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something the client already gets. Most of my work is referrals and the client decides on a design with the architect, not me.
objection: I wouldn't pay for it; the homeowner would have to agree to it, and their architect already covers this. I'm not adding a $1,500 line on a custom home when I only do a few a year.
would_change_my_mind: If the homeowner asked for it themselves and agreed in writing to pay it as a separate line item, or if it replaced something I'm already paying for.
